The '''Big Gun Turret''' was a ground emplacement weapon used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Liberation of Gerrard V]].

==Description==
[[File:Skywalkervsbiggun.png|thumb|left|180px|Skywalker engaging the ''Big Gun Turret'' on Gerrard V.]]
The Big Gun Turret was similar to the [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|XX-9 heavy turbolaser]] and the [[XX-10 turbolaser tower]]. However, it featured a much larger base, allowing it to target [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] over top of the buildings on Gerrard V. It also had a much thicker armor than the XX-9 Turbolasers, and a larger field of view, allowing it to hit targets closer to the ground. It fired in volleys as opposed to steadily like typical turbo-lasers.

==History==
The Big Gun Turret destruction was one of the objectives for Rogue Squadron during the Liberation of Gerrard V. It was destroyed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] towards the end of the battle.
